instructions: Dice the onion. Peel the 2 carrots and slice them 1/4 inch thick, then slice 2 ribs of the celery the same thickness.
Melt the 1 tbsp butter in a large soup pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring now and then, until it starts to soften.
Add the carrots and celery and cook for 3 minutes, until the onion is soft and see-through.
Sprinkle in the 1 tsp poultry seasoning, 1 tsp flour, 1/4 tsp of the salt and the 1/4 tsp pepper. Stir for 1 minute, until it smells toasty and you can't see any dry flour.
Pour in the 6 cups broth, scraping up anything stuck to the bottom, and add the bay leaf. Turn the heat up to medium high and bring it to a boil.

Stir in the 6 oz egg noodles and turn the heat down so the soup simmers. Cook for about 7 minutes, stirring now and then, until the noodles are tender. Check the bag, as some brands take a little longer.
Meanwhile, pull 2 cups of meat off the rotisserie chicken and chop it into 1/2 inch pieces. Chop 3 tbsp of the parsley.
Stir the chicken into the soup and simmer for 1 to 2 minutes, until it's hot all the way through. Fish out the bay leaf.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the parsley. Taste it, and add up to the remaining 1/4 tsp salt if it's flat.
Ladle it into bowls and serve it hot. If you're keeping some for tomorrow, the noodles keep soaking up broth in the fridge, so add a splash of water when you reheat it.
method_notes: Both versions soften onion, carrot and celery first, simmer egg noodles right in the broth, add cooked chicken at the end and finish with fresh parsley. Spend With Pennies is a quick weeknight soup: butter, poultry seasoning and a spoonful of flour cooked into the vegetables, store-bought broth, a bay leaf and already cooked chicken, about 30 minutes in all. Natasha's Kitchen makes its own broth by simmering bone-in chicken pieces with onion, garlic, bay and thyme for 1 1/2 hours, then finishes with both parsley and dill. This follows Spend With Pennies, written for 4 with the meat from a rotisserie chicken.
